ModManifest.Name: 账本：好好记账
ModManifest.Author: 一万万
ModManifest.Description:
把每天的信用点收支记清楚。
《账本：好好记账》将账本整合进游戏原生日历，打开日历即可查看当天记录，也可切换回看昨天。
### 账本功能
- 汇总每日收入、支出与净额 - 逐笔列出收支方向、顾客、交易类型、物品明细和金额 - 显示交易中实际生效的折扣或加价 - 自动折叠同名物品，并标注数量 - 支持分页查看；账本随当前游戏存档保存与读取
账本记录顾客交易及游戏内各类信用点结算，帮助你核对每天的资金变化。
---
### Keep Your Books Straight
Keep every credit movement easy to review. This mod adds a ledger page to the in-game calendar. It opens on today's transactions, and you can switch to yesterday whenever you need to look back.
### Ledger Features
- See daily totals for income, expenses, and net balance - Review each entry by direction, customer when available, transaction type, item details, and amount - See discounts or markups that were actually applied to completed trades - Fold entries for items with the same name and see the total quantity - Browse paginated records; ledger data is saved and restored with the active game save
Customer trades and in-game credit settlements are recorded from their actual balance changes, helping you keep track of where your money went.
